experiment: Stage 0b: Zoom In car circuit (mixed4c car detector spread into mixed4d dog neurons)

claims.zoom_in_2020: the car feature is stored in superposition across dog neurons and read back out downstream
claims.goodfire_2026: those neurons are generalized pose neurons shared by cars and dogs; nothing reads the combination back out

selection.C: mixed4c channel with the highest car share among its top 100 images
selection.T: 8 mixed4d channels with the largest positive weight from C
selection.D: members of T with dog share >= 0.5 among their top 100 images

predictions.P1_circuit_exists: C has car share >= 0.5 and |D| >= 3 (descriptive check that this is the Zoom In circuit)
predictions.P2_cars_in_D_examples: median car share in D's top 100 >= 0.05 (base rate 0.012) supports the essay
predictions.P3_shared_pose: among D channels with |flip preference on dogs| >= 0.3, same sign on cars in >= 75% AND >= 20 points above other mixed4d channels supports the essay; <= 60% contradicts; if fewer than 3 lateral D channels the test is uninformative
predictions.P4_readout_share: mean share of positive car attribution into car selective mixed4e channels (car share >= 0.5) that flows through D: < 0.05 supports the essay, >= 0.10 supports superposition readout, between is inconclusive
predictions.P5_combiners: the 5 mixed4e channels with the largest summed positive weight from D: all with car share < 0.25 supports the essay; any with car share >= 0.5 supports a superposition readout
